dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 先确认接手告警，再分配调查和通知任务。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Make named learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI marks allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers beside desk. Left on-call developer holds fully visible smartphone upright at chest height near center, almost front-facing. Screen contains only warning triangle with exclamation mark, no letters or numbers. Right coworker at open laptop looks toward phone and gestures calmly. Phone has speaker and rounded rectangular body, no hand over screen. Coordinated response, not panic.

coverage_review.scope: W064 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W064.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：值班同事展示完整手机，另一位同事准备调查；屏幕只有警告符号，具体告警、接手与调查由对白提供，不冒充已完成诊断。手机边框完整，手只握边缘。 布局复核：phone 气泡已避让右脸避让矩形与手势，已核对避让手势/人脸。
